finding: 82 of approximately 98 component files extend LitElement directly rather than HelixElement, leaving the vast majority of the library outside the shared base infrastructure.
recommendation: Migrate all LitElement extends to HelixElement. Prioritize form-adjacent components (hx-dialog, hx-accordion, hx-card, hx-tabs, hx-toast, hx-drawer) in the first wave, then systematically migrate the remaining presentational components. A codemods script would be appropriate at this scale.

finding: All 16 components that do extend HelixElement correctly declare static override formAssociated = true where form participation is required, and use _internals via the lazy accessor pattern.

HelixRadio extends LitElement directly even though it is a child of a form-associated group and needs coordinated accessibility attribute management — it sets aria-label and aria-checked via direct setAttribute calls in connectedCallback rather than using the HelixElement infrastructure.
recommendation: Migrate to HelixElement. Move ARIA attribute management into updated() lifecycle using Lit's reactive property system rather than raw setAttribute in connectedCallback.

finding: HelixDialog extends LitElement directly, missing form lifecycle hooks (_onFormReset, _onFormDisabled) and the lazy _internals accessor that HelixElement provides. Dialogs commonly contain forms — the base class provides infrastructure the component cannot currently use.

FormMixin is not exported from either the mixins barrel (mixins/index.ts) or the main library barrel (index.ts), yet it is used by hx-checkbox and hx-text-input imported via a direct file-path import from FormMixin.js. This creates an undiscoverable internal API surface.
recommendation: Export FormMixin and FormMixinInterface from mixins/index.ts and re-export from packages/hx-library/src/index.ts alongside FocusMixin. This makes the mixin discoverable and consistent with the FocusMixin export pattern.

finding: Only 2 components (hx-text-input, hx-checkbox) use FormMixin for interaction state tracking (dirty/touched/pristine), while 16 total components are form-associated. Components such as hx-select, hx-switch, hx-slider, hx-textarea, hx-number-input, hx-radio-group, hx-date-picker, and hx-time-picker implement their own validation logic without the shared mixin, leading to inconsistent dirty/touched behavior across the form system.
recommendation: Systematically adopt FormMixin across all form-associated HelixElement subclasses. The mixin is already well-designed and the HelixElement base class provides the _internals accessor it relies on. Delegate implementation to lit-specialist per component.

finding: HelixSelect duplicates checkValidity(), reportValidity(), form getter, validity getter, and validationMessage getter that are already provided by HelixElement and FormMixin. This is copy-paste pattern that will diverge from the base.
recommendation: Apply FormMixin to HelixSelect and remove the duplicate validity delegation methods. The _updateValidity hook in FormMixin is the correct extension point for the required-field validation logic already present.

finding: The size property uses attribute 'hx-size' (30 components follow this pattern), but the attribute name creates a naming inconsistency: the property is named 'size' while the attribute is 'hx-size'. This is intentional to avoid collisions with native size attributes, but it is not documented in a shared convention file and not applied uniformly — hx-spinner uses size without hx- prefix.
recommendation: Document the hx-size attribute convention explicitly in a CONVENTIONS.md or ADR. Audit all size-bearing components and enforce the hx-size attribute attribute uniformly. Update CEM documentation to note the discrepancy from the DOM property name.

finding: Event naming is consistent across components — all custom events use the hx- prefix (hx-click, hx-input, hx-change, hx-expand, etc.) with bubbles: true and composed: true. This is correct and uniform.

Deprecated Wc* type aliases (WcBadge, WcContainer, WcDivider, WcSwitch, WcTag, WcTheme, WcTreeView, WcTreeItem, WcNav, WcTextInput, WcTextarea, WcSelect) are still exported from both component files and the main barrel index.ts with no @deprecated JSDoc marker in the barrel exports, creating unguided API confusion for consumers.
recommendation: Add @deprecated JSDoc tags to all Wc* barrel re-exports. Add a deprecation timeline to the CHANGELOG. Set a target release (e.g., 4.0.0) for removal and enforce via a lint rule or TypeScript @deprecated directive.

finding: The main barrel index.ts is well-structured with section comments, consistent named exports, and type-only exports correctly using export type. Auto-generation comment is present. No circular dependency risk detected — component index files re-export from sibling files without back-importing from the root barrel.

mixinDelegatesAria is exported from mixins/index.ts (and therefore available to consumers importing from the mixins path) but is intentionally absent from the main library barrel src/index.ts. The mixin is still actively used internally in 3 components (hx-button, hx-checkbox, hx-file-upload), and the AriadDelegationMixinInterface alias carries a typo ('Ariad') that is marked @deprecated but remains in the public mixins barrel export.
recommendation: Either promote mixinDelegatesAria removal to a tracked deprecation with a timeline, or move it to an internal-only path. Remove the typo'd AriadDelegationMixinInterface alias in the next major version. The mixin's presence in mixins/index.ts while absent from the main barrel creates an inconsistent contract.

finding: Shadow DOM encapsulation is correctly applied across all components. All components use the default open shadow root. part= attributes are used for meaningful external styling hooks (button, input, label, error, help-text, etc.) following lowercase-hyphenated conventions. No CSS leakage patterns detected.

:host { display: ... } is set in 90 of 93 style files. The 3 exceptions are justified: hx-visually-hidden uses absolute positioning instead of display, hx-prose sets display via inline style in connectedCallback, and hx-form imports an external scoped CSS file that sets display. No :host display omissions detected among interactive components.

Cross-component imports are minimal and appropriate: hx-split-button imports type HelixMenuItem for its menu item reference, and hx-checkbox-group imports type HelixCheckbox for child element queries. Both are type-only imports that do not create runtime coupling.

hx-select registers a document-level click listener for outside-click detection in its updated() lifecycle. This is a known pattern but document-level listeners that are not properly scoped can cause issues when multiple select instances are open simultaneously or when the component is used inside Shadow DOM contexts where composed events may behave unexpectedly.
recommendation: Consider replacing the document-level click listener with a Popover API or focus-based approach. At minimum, audit that the listener is always cleaned up in disconnectedCallback (it is), and add a comment explaining why composedPath() comparison is used.

finding: The three-tier token cascade (component token → semantic token → primitive fallback) is correctly implemented in most components. hx-dialog, hx-button, hx-text-input, hx-select all follow the correct pattern: --hx-dialog-bg → --hx-color-neutral-0. The cascade depth is appropriate.

hx-card.styles.ts contains a three-tier cascade that bottoms out at a hardcoded #ffffff primitive fallback: var(--hx-card-bg, var(--hx-color-neutral-0, #ffffff)). While the #ffffff is an emergency fallback for when tokens are absent, it is a hardcoded value at the bottom of a component token cascade and violates the no-hardcoded-values rule.
recommendation: The bottom-tier fallback should reference a design token primitive or be omitted in favour of the semantic token. Evaluate whether #ffffff fallbacks throughout the codebase can be replaced by var(--hx-color-neutral-0) without the raw hex, relying on the token system being always-loaded via document-token-adoption.

finding: hx-button.styles.ts uses rgba() hardcoded fallback values in the inverted variant context (e.g., var(--hx-overlay-white-15, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15))). These are overlay tokens that may not exist in the token system yet, leaving rgba() hardcoded values as live production fallbacks.
recommendation: Formalize --hx-overlay-white-15, --hx-overlay-white-20, --hx-overlay-white-25, --hx-overlay-white-50, --hx-overlay-white-70 as official semantic tokens in the design token system. Until they are defined in the token sheet, these fallbacks are correct but represent missing token coverage.

finding: devWarn() is used consistently across components for invalid prop values (hx-button variant clamping, hx-select size validation, hx-text-input type=number non-numeric value warning). Error states use role=alert with aria-atomic=true on error containers. Form validation uses ElementInternals.setValidity() correctly with anchor element references.

hx-select.ts calls _updateValidity() directly in updated() rather than routing through the FormMixin lifecycle hook pattern. Additionally, _updateValidity is a private method rather than the protected hook that FormMixin defines, creating a naming collision risk if FormMixin is later applied.
recommendation: Refactor the validity update pattern to align with FormMixin's _updateValidity hook convention (protected, not private) before applying FormMixin. This avoids a silent override issue where FormMixin's updated() would call _updateValidity expecting FormMixin semantics.

finding: hx-text-input implements complete constraint validation: required, minlength, maxlength, with correct ElementInternals.setValidity() calls that include the anchor element reference for focus management. Form reset, form state restore, and form disabled lifecycle hooks are all implemented correctly via HelixElement overrides.

FocusMixin is defined to accept Constructor<LitElement> rather than Constructor<HelixElement>, which is architecturally correct (it does not depend on form internals), but it means the mixin chain FocusMixin(HelixElement) works correctly while also permitting FocusMixin(LitElement) chains that bypass the base infrastructure. Only 1 component (hx-text-input) uses FocusMixin, suggesting adoption is far below the target for interactive inputs.
recommendation: Apply FocusMixin to all interactive components with inner focusable elements: hx-select, hx-switch, hx-slider, hx-number-input, hx-textarea, hx-date-picker, hx-time-picker, hx-combobox, hx-checkbox. The mixin eliminates per-component focusin/focusout event management boilerplate.

finding: SUMMARY — Top 5 Systemic Architectural Issues: (1) BASE CLASS MIGRATION INCOMPLETE: 82 of ~98 component files extend LitElement directly instead of HelixElement. This is the single largest architectural risk — these components lack form lifecycle hooks, lazy _internals accessor, and any future shared infrastructure added to HelixElement. (2) FORMMIXIN ADOPTION GAPS: FormMixin exists and is well-designed but is used by only 2 of 16 form-associated components, creating inconsistent dirty/touched/pristine tracking and duplicated validity delegation boilerplate across the other 14. (3) FOCUSMIXIN UNDER-ADOPTION: FocusMixin is used by 1 component (hx-text-input) despite being applicable to at least 9 interactive components — every other interactive component implements its own focus event management ad-hoc. (4) DEPRECATED API SURFACE NOT SUNSET: Wc* type aliases (9+ types) remain in the main barrel without @deprecated markers or removal timeline. mixinDelegatesAria exports a typo'd alias. These create permanent maintenance debt. (5) OVERLAY TOKEN GAP: rgba() hardcoded fallbacks for inverted/overlay contexts (--hx-overlay-white-*) are live in production because the semantic tokens they reference are not yet defined in the token system — violating the no-hardcoded-values rule in a way that cannot be fixed without first filling the token system gap.
recommendation: Prioritize: (1) Create a migration script to bulk-migrate LitElement extends to HelixElement across all 82 files. (2) Apply FormMixin to all form-associated components in a single targeted sprint. (3) Apply FocusMixin to all interactive components with inner focusable elements. (4) Set a deprecation timeline for Wc* aliases targeting the next major version. (5) Define --hx-overlay-white-* tokens formally in the design token system.
